rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday word for a handheld knife, including one used as a weapon rather than specifically a dagger.

example.english: Be careful—the kitchen knife is very sharp.
example.jyutping: siu2 sam1 di1 cyu4 fong2 baa2 dou1 hou2 lei6

rows.note: Use this for a blade or cutting part fitted into a machine or tool, rather than an ordinary handheld knife.

example.english: The razor's knife blade has gone dull, so it needs replacing.
example.traditional: 剃鬚刀嘅刀片鈍咗，要換喇。
example.jyutping: tai3 sou1 dou1 ge3 dou1 pin3 deon6 zo2 jiu3 wun6 laa3

rows.note: Use this for the more specific sense of a dagger, especially in formal or written contexts.

example.english: Police found a knife—specifically a dagger—at the scene.
example.traditional: 警方於現場發現一把匕首。
example.jyutping: ging2 fong1 jyu1 jin6 coeng4 faat3 jin6 jat1 baa2 bei6 sau2
